name: orch-guard
description: Enforces the coding-orchestrator rules at tool-call time: role/model routing, main-session-only actions, checks after the last edit, and critic review before risky work ships.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: enforce: refuse calls that break a rule. warn: let them run and remind the model. off: only track.

riskyPattern.title: Extra risky paths
riskyPattern.description: A regular expression; edited paths it matches also need a critic SHIP before push or publish.

checkPattern.title: Extra check commands
checkPattern.description: A regular expression matched at the head of a command; matching commands also count as checks (for example `just test|\./scripts/ci`).
